reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness runtime focused on reducing prompt and tool-schema overhead through short persona context, local rendering, and progressive tool disclosure.

summaries.zh: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness 优化上下文和工具暴露的插件，通过短 persona、本地渲染与按需解锁工具降低运行时开销。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that reduces runtime overhead through concise persona context, local rendering, and on-demand tool disclosure.

capabilities: Adds a short persona to model context
Renders persona styling locally in the interface
Restricts and progressively unlocks available agent tools
